brief.product: Front-desk and clinician scheduling for a three-location PT practice. Used all day by reception and therapists.
brief.notes: Older patients see the sign-in page. Nothing that looks like a bank.

accent.why: A deep teal reads as clinical without being cold, and is far from the reds and ambers used for alerts.

temperature.why: Warm greys soften a screen used by patients and staff in a care setting.

pairing.why: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for an older audience; the mono second face handles appointment codes.

radius.why: No reason in the brief to go sharp or round.

density.why: Reception uses it all day and works from the schedule table.

motif.why: A mono pairing and a schedule full of codes suit uppercase labels.

copy.headline: Today's schedule, all three clinics.
copy.tagline: Sign in to see who is coming in and who is running late.
copy.why: Speaks to what reception opens the app to do.
